short.en: The cheapest route through a picture

t.zh: 现在换成真正的图片。图片也是一张表，每一格是一个像素。这一章的图片来自《视觉完备》的测试图库：灰色的背景上，写着几个亮的字母。
t.en: Now for real pictures. A picture is a table too, with one pixel per cell. This chapter’s pictures come from Vision Complete’s test images: a few bright letters on a grey background.

t.zh: 想把图片变窄一点，又不想把字母挤变形。办法是找一条从顶行到底行的缝：每行一个像素，每一步走到正下、左下或右下。拿掉这条缝，图片就窄了一列。
t.en: You want to make the picture a little narrower without squashing the letters. The trick is to find a seam from the top row to the bottom row: one pixel per row, each step going straight down, down-left or down-right. Take that seam out and the picture is one column narrower.

t.zh: 拿掉哪条缝最不显眼？看能量：一个像素和左右、上下的邻居差得越多，能量越高（字母的边缘），平平的背景能量很低。《视觉完备》里算过的边缘，就是这里的能量。缝上的能量加起来越小越好。
t.en: Which seam is least noticeable to remove? Look at the energy: the more a pixel differs from its neighbours left and right, above and below, the higher its energy (the edges of letters), while flat background has very little. The edges you computed in Vision Complete are the energy here. The lower a seam’s total energy, the better.

t.zh: 这不就是吗？只是走法换成了从上往下，来路换成了左上、正上、右上三格。表里每一格记「从顶行到这里，最省的缝要花多少能量」；最底一行里最小的那一格，就是整条缝的能量。格子角上的小数字是这个像素自己的能量。
t.en: Isn’t this just ? Only now you walk from top to bottom, and the ways in are the three cells up-left, up and up-right. Each cell of the table records “the least energy a seam from the top row to here can cost”; the smallest cell in the bottom row is the energy of the whole seam. The small number in a cell’s corner is that pixel’s own energy.

goal.zh: 算出每张图片里能量最小的缝：从顶行到底行，每行一个像素，每一步走到正下、左下或右下；缝的能量是一路上像素能量之和。
goal.en: Find the lowest-energy seam in each picture: from the top row to the bottom row, one pixel per row, each step going straight down, down-left or down-right; a seam’s energy is the sum of the pixel energies along it.

how.zh: 这一关会检查整张表。通过后，左边的小图上会标出这条缝。
how.en: This level checks the whole table. Once you pass, the seam is marked on the small picture to the left.

title.zh: 缝也是一条最省的路线
title.en: A seam is a cheapest route too

body.zh: 每一格 = 本格能量 + 上面三格里最小的。和<level-ref to="cheapest"></level-ref>一样，只是来路换了方向。
body.en: Each cell = its own energy + the smallest of the three cells above. Just like <level-ref to="cheapest"></level-ref>, only with the ways in turned round.

body.zh: 缝沿着背景走，绕开了字母的边缘：边缘的能量太高，经过它太「贵」。
body.en: The seam runs through the background and skirts the letters’ edges: their energy is too high, so crossing them is too “expensive”.

note.zh: 缝：每一格 = 本格能量 + 左上、正上、右上三格里最小的。
note.en: Seam: each cell = its own energy + the smallest of up-left, up and up-right.

say.zh: 只看正上方，缝就只能是一根笔直的竖线，剪掉时会从字母中间切过去。缝每一步可以往左下或右下斜一格：左上、右上也是来路。
say.en: Looking only straight up, a seam can only be a dead-straight vertical line, and cutting it out would slice through the middle of a letter. At each step a seam may slant one cell down-left or down-right, so up-left and up-right are ways in too.

hints.zh: 三条来路：左上、正上、右上，取较小。
hints.en: Three ways in: up-left, up and up-right. Take the min.

hints.zh: 再加上这个像素自己的能量。顶行上面什么都没有：用放行闸在顶行送一个 0 进去（和<level-ref to="cheapest"></level-ref>的起点一样）。
hints.en: Then add this pixel’s own energy. There is nothing above the top row: use a Pass gate to let a 0 in on the top row (just like the start in <level-ref to="cheapest"></level-ref>).

solution: c = min(view.ul, view.up, facts.top, facts.energy, view.ur)
